title: How to Start Print on Demand With $0 Upfront Investment in 2026 (STEP BY STEP for Beginners)
summary: A Printify pop-up store tutorial pitched as print-on-demand with no upfront money, plus a doodle-to-design technique.

assertions.quote: a great way to start an online business with literally no money. Like you don't have to put any money into this

verdicts.note: Pop-up and marketplace integrations take payment before fulfilment so there is no upfront cost, though samples and traffic still cost money or time.

assertions.quote: it's free to sign up literally
if you just post your Printify store and you're like, I don't know why I'm not getting sales and you're not marketing
There's a great way to do it for free and that's actually on Pinterest.

verdicts.note: Pinterest can send search traffic to product pins, but results for new accounts are slow and uncertain.
